title: IOAgent: Democratizing Trustworthy HPC I/O Performance Diagnosis Capability via LLMs

live_model.evidence: one uses the proprietary gpt-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13) model from OpenAI, and the other uses the open-source Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct (Section VII); ION baseline also uses gpt-4o-2024-05-13

prompt.location: Fig. 1 (direct-query prompt); IOAgent stage prompts are described in Section IV but not printed in full ('Due to space constraints')

claim.location: Table IV, row IOAgent-gpt-4o, column Overall Accuracy

data.source: TraceBench (Darshan traces: synthetic C benchmarks, 21 IO500 configurations, 9 real applications); release not stated in the text

notes: Metrics are anonymized 1-4 rankings by GPT-4o among four tools, so re-execution also needs Drishti and ION outputs; trace counts for the synthetic subset are not given.
